$comment: Chariots of Atlantis - rung 1 gate chain. DERIVED from BUILD-SHEET.md via LANDING-MAP.md, not authored. The canonical chain: scorers and walls READ this file; a scorer that reimplements the chain from prose will drift from it. Content-hash this file and record the hash with every run (GROUNDING.md section 5).

notes.depth: Only entries with counted=true contribute to traversal depth. Inspection gates are conformance, not performance - they are pass/void via fuse and are excluded from the denominator.
notes.gauges: Entries with kind=gauge record a number and never pass or fail. A limit that is only recorded is a gauge; a limit with a target is a gate.
notes.blocked: Entries with blockedBy set cannot be written until that decision closes. They are counted in the denominator so the score does not silently inflate when they land.

gates.asserts: every source file parses
all content validates against its JSON Schema
every drop, shop entry, spell list, map exit and key-item gate resolves
no identifier appears in model output; all IDs are code-allocated and collision-free
every proper noun in output appears in the terms file
entity counts, systems LOC and authored-exception count are inside their declared bands
the corpus regenerates byte-identical from the spec; a hand-edited row fails
the artifact starts
lit pixels > 0 read via gl.readPixels from inside the live GL context
gates.note: attempt 2 died here at 20/20 on check.mjs

gates.asserts: fixed timestep present and dt clamped
no per-frame allocation growth
the scripted deterministic bot completes the slice
no unrecoverable resource state; win state reachable
accuracy monotonic in Hit% across the FULL stat range
damage monotonic in Attack
XP thresholds strictly increasing
no stat overflow at max level
every damage roll falls inside the declared band over N samples
for all stat combinations in range, damage >= 1
higher speed acts no later
exactly the declared verbs exist and no more
every enemy is reachable by at least one targeting mode
no composition is degenerate AND every reasonable composition can finish

gates.asserts: two runs at one seed produce identical transcripts
N battles with no crash, overflow, softlock or unbounded memory growth
correctness sustained at volume; results do not degrade under load

every artifact resolves to component + instruction-set hash + oracle values
